title: Firefly Shepherd
short: Guide glowing fireflies through a night forest into the jar before dawn.
full:
Firefly Shepherd is a calm, glowing puzzle-action game. Move your light with one finger and a swarm of fireflies follows it. Lead them through the night forest into a glass jar before dawn.

Go carefully: fireflies left behind in the dark fade away.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag your light and the swarm follows
• Bring the fireflies into the jar before the night ends
• Save half the swarm to pass a level, 75% for two stars and 90% for three
• Rescue the Queen Firefly for a bonus

FOREST HAZARDS
• Branches block the path
• Spider webs catch fireflies, but a big group can break through
• Wind pushes the swarm off course
• Frogs snap at fireflies that come too close
• Bats swoop down for a snack

FEATURES
• Endless levels across four forests: blue woods, marsh, cherry blossom and autumn
• Nine firefly colours and three upgrades in the coin shop
• Weekly League: earn points by clearing levels and climb the weekly top list. The top 3 players each week win gold, silver and bronze badges that stay on your profile
• English and Urdu
• Short levels, one-finger controls, works offline (the league needs internet)

ADS AND PURCHASES
The game is free to play and shows ads. You can choose to watch a short video to double your coins after a level. Optional in-app purchases: remove ads, and coin packs.

اردو
فائر فلائی شیفرڈ ایک پُرسکون اور چمکتا ہوا کھیل ہے۔ انگلی سے اپنی روشنی چلائیں، جگنوؤں کا جھنڈ اس کے پیچھے آئے گا۔ صبح ہونے سے پہلے انہیں جنگل سے نکال کر شیشے کے جار تک پہنچائیں۔ شاخیں، مکڑی کے جالے، ہوا، مینڈک اور چمگادڑ راستے میں آئیں گے۔ ہر ہفتے لیگ میں حصہ لیں اور ٹاپ 3 میں آ کر سونے، چاندی یا کانسی کا بیج جیتیں۔ گیم مفت ہے اور اس میں ایڈز آتے ہیں۔ چاہیں تو ایڈز ہٹانے یا سکے لینے کی خریداری بھی کر سکتے ہیں۔
contentRating: Everyone (no violence; frogs/bats 'catch' fireflies with no blood)
notes: No music; game has no audio at all. Ads: AdMob banner, interstitial at natural breaks (max every 3 min, not in first 2 breaks), opt-in rewarded x2 coins. IAP: remove_ads (non-consumable), coins_small 1500, coins_large 7500 (consumables).
